title: With a Grain of SALT: Are LLMs Fair Across Social Dimensions?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring bias scores by generating text for male and female groups across five triggers (General Debate, Positioned Debate, Career Advice, Problem Solving, and CV Generation), anonymizing the real-world outputs, and using an automated LLM judge (DeepSeek-R1) to determine win rates or negative role assignments.

Evaluating pairwise bias scores by generating text for different religious groups (Muslim, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, Atheist) across five tasks, anonymizing the outputs to remove explicit identifiers, and utilizing an automated LLM judge to compute preference win rates.

Comparing model-generated outputs for various racial/ethnic groups (White, African-American, Hispanic, Asian, Native-Hawaiian, American-Indian) across debate and real-world scenarios, and quantifying biases through an LLM judge's preference evaluations on anonymized output pairs.
